newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Leighton sees yr revenue A$2.7-2.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Leighton sees yr revenue A$2.7-2.8 bln.

text.p: The managing director of construction group Leighton Holdings Ltd, Wal King, said on Thursday he expected the company's total revenue to reach between A$2.7 to A$2.8 billion in the year to June 30, 1997.

"In terms of size, we are least double the size of any other construction company in Australia -- this year our revenues will be, I suspect, around A$2.7 to A$2.8 billion," King told a news conference.
Leighton, which is 49 percent owned by German construction group Hochtief Ag, earlier reported a net profit of A$32.04 million for the six months ended December 31, 1996.
At 11.30 a.m. (0030 GMT) Leighton shares were trading at A$5.80, down five cents on the day.
